news.headline: Nasdaq pre-market +2.26% on AI stocks surge
news.what_happened: US Nasdaq futures/extended hours are indicating a strong +2.26% move driven by a surge in AI-related technology stocks. S&P 500 futures also showing +1.49%.
news.why_it_matters: Indian IT exporters—TCS, INFY, WIPRO, HCLTECH—closely track Nasdaq sentiment. A 2%+ Nasdaq session typically translates to 1.5-2.5% gains in large-cap IT on NSE. FII portfolio managers also re-rate IT sector on strong US tech signals.

news.headline: Asian markets rally: Nikkei +1.38%, Hang Seng +0.59%
news.what_happened: Japan's Nikkei gained 882 points to 65,019 and Hong Kong's Hang Seng rose 148 points to 25,190, driven by broad risk-on sentiment across Asia.
news.why_it_matters: Positive Asian cues reduce early-session selling pressure in India. GIFT Nifty at 23,509 signals a modest ~95pt gap-up above Nifty's Sep 21 cash close of 23,414. FII allocations to EM Asia correlate with pan-Asian performance.

news.headline: DII net bought ₹2,797 Cr on Sep 21, overwhelming FII selling of ₹576 Cr
news.what_happened: Domestic institutional investors led by mutual funds and LIC were aggressive buyers on Monday, absorbing FII net selling of ₹576 Cr. Net institutional flow was strongly positive at +₹2,221 Cr.
news.why_it_matters: Strong DII support at 23,300-23,400 Nifty levels signals domestic funds see value here. This creates a demand floor in banking and large-cap index heavyweights. Net institutional flow positive is a bullish setup.

news.headline: Brent Crude +0.59% to $96.81 on Gulf supply curtailments
news.what_happened: Global oil prices edged up as ~10 mb/d of Gulf output remained shut amid ongoing security risks. IEA September 2026 report forecasts demand falling 2.5 mb/d in 2026 but supply disruptions keep prices elevated.
news.why_it_matters: Brent crossing the 0.5% threshold is a mild cost headwind for airlines (jet fuel ~40% of OPEX), paints, and tyres. However, upstream producers ONGC/OIL benefit from higher per-barrel realization, and OMCs get inventory gains.

news.headline: NSE IPO allotment today; BSE listing scheduled Sep 24
news.what_happened: National Stock Exchange's ₹22,562 Cr IPO (price band ₹1,700-₹1,785) closed on Sep 21 with 2x+ subscription. Allotment of shares occurs today (Sep 22); shares to list on BSE on September 24.
news.why_it_matters: NSE IPO allotment day creates positive retail investor sentiment and draws attention to the exchange ecosystem. BSE, CDSL, and CAMS benefit from elevated market participation and interest.

picks.catalyst: Nasdaq pre-market/extended hours +2.26% on AI stock surge
picks.logic: TCS derives ~55% revenue from North America. A 2%+ Nasdaq day historically correlates with 1.5-2% moves in TCS. High FII ownership (>14%) means US tech sentiment directly re-rates the stock. Prev close ₹2,128.70; watch zone ±0.5%.

picks.catalyst: Nasdaq pre-market +2.26%; higher beta to US tech sentiment than TCS
picks.logic: INFY typically shows 1.1x beta vs. large-cap IT peers on Nasdaq-driven days. ~60% Americas revenue with USD/INR stable at 95.81 (no FX drag). Clean catalyst, direct P&L mechanism. Prev close ₹1,038.50.

picks.catalyst: DII net bought ₹2,797 Cr on Sep 21; US 10Y yield declining to 4.96%
picks.logic: DII buying of ₹2,797 Cr overwhelmingly flows into HDFCBANK—India's largest DII holding. Combined with Asian risk-on (Nikkei +1.38%) and US 10Y yield easing 3.5 bps, rate-sensitive banking gets dual tailwind of domestic demand and macro rate relief. Prev close ₹739.50.

risks: GIFT Nifty at 23,509 (-0.11% from its own prev close) signals only a modest ~95pt gap-up — if Nifty fails to sustain 23,450, momentum fades quickly
FII were net sellers ₹576 Cr on Sep 21; if selling continues today, IT and banking face supply pressure regardless of global cues
Brent crude at +0.59% is a headwind for airlines, paints, tyres — avoid INDIGO, ASIANPAINT, MRF longs today
China Manufacturing PMI at 49.8 (sub-50 contraction) is a drag on metals — no aggressive longs in TATASTEEL, JSWSTEEL
USD/INR at 95.81 unchanged — no additional currency tailwind for IT exporters beyond the Nasdaq signal itself
